title: Sportswear HO19 / Explore Strada portrait layout

location.series: Annie Nguyen / Nike Sportswear Core Holiday 2019

slide_intent: Tie a short promise to a visible use setting so viewers can connect a product name with an everyday activity.
strategic_value: The exploration message and stair-side footwear can position Explore Strada as ready for movement through ordinary surroundings.
demonstration: A taped photograph shows black-and-lime shoes on steps; the product name sits in the frame, with a short exploration headline below.
practical_value: Evaluate whether a campaign phrase has a concrete visual counterpart rather than relying on copy alone.

content_islands.name: Product on steps
content_islands.spec: Place the close-up of shoes and legs within the taped pale frame.

content_islands.name: Supporting surroundings
content_islands.spec: Layer lime texture, teal surfaces and smaller wearer photographs behind the frame.

content_islands.name: Name and promise
content_islands.spec: Keep the brush-like product name in the frame and the white headline, supporting line and signature below.
